# vlc-skins-high-dpi /docs Knowledge Base

## Core Purpose
Usability and accessibility research for VLC Skins2 focusing on High-DPI and Touch interfaces.

## Authoritative Docs
- project-charter.md: Purpose, Objectives, Non-Goals.
- touch-guidelines.md: Target sizes (Min: 40x40 DIP; Play/Pause: 64x64; Others: 56x56).
- high-dpi-guidelines.md: Scaling validation (150%, 200%, 300%).
- research-measurement-template.md: Standard data collection format.
- /references/: Source binary skins and Skins2 spec.

## Key Constraints
- Goal: High-DPI/Touch usability.
- Non-Goals: No UWP recreation, No Fluent Design clone, No VLC fork.
- Philosophy: Simple by default, powerful when needed (KDE style).
